name: eu.surfbooking/surfbooking
title: Surf Booking: Surf Lessons & Surf Forecast
description: Find and compare surf lessons from verified schools, plus the surf forecast per beach and level.

tools.name: search_lessons
tools.description: Search bookable surf lessons on SurfBooking by free-text query (zone, beach, level, activity), with optional structured filters (level, maxPrice, date range). Returns upcoming lessons with date, time, spot, level, school, price and a booking link, and says how many matched. All times are local Europe/Lisbon. SurfBooking zones with schools only: Portugal and Spain. Read-only — does not book or charge anything. It returns lessons, not a ranking of where the surf is good right now. Great for 'aulas de surf na Ericeira', 'beginner lessons this weekend' or 'surf lesson under 40 euros'. This is the general search by place, level, date and price; it does not filter by what the sea is doing, and it does not search hotels.

query.description: Free text in Portuguese, English, Spanish, French, German or Italian, e.g. 'beginner Carcavelos', 'aulas iniciante Ericeira', 'kurs morgen Ericeira' or 'cours debutant Peniche'. Min 2 chars.

maxPrice.description: Optional — only lessons at or below this price in EUR, e.g. 50.

from.description: Optional — earliest date, YYYY-MM-DD (Europe/Lisbon). For a single day, set from and to to the same date.

tools.name: lesson_details
tools.description: Get full details of a specific bookable lesson by its id (date, time, level, price, duration, spots left, what's included). Takes a lesson id from a lesson search result. Read-only. Great for 'tell me more about that lesson' or 'o que está incluído nessa aula'.

lessonId.description: The lesson id from a lesson search result.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Get the secure SurfBooking link a user opens to BOOK and PAY for a lesson. NEVER books or charges — only returns the URL; the human completes the purchase. Great for 'send me the payment link' or 'manda-me o link para pagar essa aula'.

lessonId.description: The lesson id from a lesson search result.

tools.name: surf_forecast
tools.description: Get the SurfBooking forecast for a surf spot by name (e.g. 'Carcavelos', 'Ericeira', 'Matosinhos', 'Peniche'). Returns the current 0–10 surf score with label, the level-relevant wave height, period and wind, PLUS a multi-day outlook (the best daylight window per day for the next ~week) so you can answer 'which day this week should I book a lesson?'. The score is level-aware and scored per spot (proprietary). Read-only, SurfBooking zones only: Portugal, Spain, South Africa, Italy and Morocco, times Europe/Lisbon. Books or charges nothing.

spot.description: Surf spot or beach name, e.g. 'Carcavelos' or 'Ericeira'. Min 2 chars.

level.description: Optional — the surfer's level. Tailors BOTH the score and the multi-day outlook to that level.

tools.name: size_equipment
tools.description: Recommend surf gear sizes (wetsuit, board, leash, and boots if a shoe size is given) from a person's weight, height and surf level. Pure EU/Portugal sizing calculation — read-only, books or charges nothing. Useful before picking a lesson so the right gear is ready. Great for 'what wetsuit size do I need' or 'que prancha para 80 kg e 1,80 m'.

height.description: Height in centimetres, e.g. 180. Optional — improves the wetsuit fit.

shoeSizeEu.description: EU shoe size, e.g. 42. Optional — only needed for boots sizing.

tools.name: list_zones
tools.description: List the surf zones/regions covered by SurfBooking (SurfBooking zones only: Portugal, Spain, South Africa, Italy and Morocco), with how many certified schools each has and whether lessons are bookable. Answers an open 'where can I learn to surf?' / 'best region for beginners?' question. This is about REGIONS and school coverage, never live sea conditions or per-level rankings.

tools.name: list_spots
tools.description: List surf beaches (spots), optionally filtered to one zone/region, with bottom type and a short description so you can pick beginner-friendly beaches. Returns beaches, not forecasts or lessons. Great for 'which beaches are in Ericeira' or 'praias boas para iniciantes no Algarve'.

zone.description: Optional — zone/region name to filter by, e.g. 'Ericeira' or 'Lagos'. Omit for all spots.

tools.name: recommend_spots
tools.description: Recommend the top surf beaches in SurfBooking zones right now. Pass `level` for a LEVEL-AWARE ranking — the best spots for a beginner / advanced surfer at this moment, weighted by how well each spot's live wave fits that level. Without `level`, ranks by the live SurfBooking Index (conditions + activity). Best for 'where's good to surf now?' / 'best beach for a beginner today?'. Optionally filter by zone. It ranks beaches for right now, not the best day ahead, and returns no lessons. This returns BEACHES, not lessons.

zone.description: Optional — zone/region name to filter by, e.g. 'Ericeira'.

level.description: Optional — surfer level. When given, ranks spots by how well each one's live conditions fit that level (a 0.6m beach is great for a beginner, poor for advanced).

limit.description: Optional — how many to return (default 6, max 12).

tools.name: find_lessons_by_conditions
tools.description: Find bookable surf lessons whose forecast sea, at the lesson's own beach and hour, matches the given criteria: minimum open-sea wave height, minimum surf score (0–10), light wind, and/or a level and zone. Returns real upcoming lessons with date, time (Europe/Lisbon), beach, the forecast for that hour, level, price, school, lesson id and booking link. Lessons whose hour has no forecast yet are left out when a sea criterion is given, and the reply says how many. Great for 'find beginner lessons when the sea is at least 1m', 'lessons on days with light wind' or 'surf quando o mar tiver pelo menos 1.5m'. Read-only, SurfBooking zones with schools only: Portugal and Spain. Books or charges nothing. It always returns lessons, never a plain ranking of beaches.

waveMin.description: Optional — minimum open-sea wave height in metres at the lesson's hour, e.g. 1 or 1.5.

scoreMin.description: Optional — minimum SurfBooking sea score (0–10) at the lesson's hour.

level.description: Optional — only lessons for this level.

days.description: Optional — how many days ahead to look, from today (default 7, max 14).

lightWind.description: Optional — if true, only lessons whose hour has wind of 30 km/h or less.

tools.name: best_surf_today
tools.description: Return the top surf spots in SurfBooking zones right now, ranked by current live conditions. Scores every active SurfBooking spot (wave height, swell period, wind, coast facing) and returns the best ones with wave height, wind, surf score, level suitability, and a link to each beach's page with its lessons. Great for 'what's the best surf spot today?', 'onde está o surf melhor agora?', or 'melhores condições de surf em Portugal'. Conditions are cached from the live forecast and updated every 15 minutes. Read-only, SurfBooking zones only: Portugal, Spain, South Africa, Italy and Morocco. The ranking is by live conditions only, not weighted to one surfer level.

limit.description: Number of spots to return (default 8, max 20).

level.description: Optional — filter to spots suitable for this level.
